mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak housing starts (HOUST below 1500) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 260) indicates a demand shock that increases uncertainty and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST < 1500 and CPIAUCSL > 260 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, strong housing starts (HOUST above 1550) signal robust consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when HOUST exceeds 1550, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates a stronger labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 5-day SPX returns is negative in more than 55% of 2-year rolling windows, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 142,000) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO below 105) indicates a mismatch between labor demand and supply capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 142,000 and INDPRO < 105 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, weak industrial production (INDPRO below 105) indicates reduced manufacturing output and potential supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during supply shocks when INDPRO is below 105, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
